humanites.name: La bibliothèque · The library
humanites.alt: The double-height reading room of the faculty library under a round skylight, seen from the near left: tall oak bookcases, a wrought-iron gallery with a spiral staircase, long reading tables with green lamps and a marble poet bust. On the left a forgetful librarian is covered in yellow memo notes, a white-haired connoisseur in a bow tie savours an old book, a girl leaps up in a beam of sunlight with a sudden idea, and a porter's trolley tips a huge heap of books onto the floor while children at the table sit up. In front a boy with cookie crumbs on his chin pleads beside an empty cookie jar. On the right an old sailor holds a pink conch shell to his ear, a surfer with a surfboard raises an eyebrow, a man at the tall window looks through binoculars, and a lady in teal listens to a red crayfish whispering on her shoulder. The glass entrance doors on the left lead out to the campus; on the gallery the cream laurel door leads to philosophy, the green quill door to literature, the crown door to history, the blue door to linguistics and the lilac door to psychology, and the spiral staircase climbs to the upper gallery.

doors.hint: the cream door with the laurel wreath up on the gallery, to the philosophy room

philosophie.name: La salle de philosophie · The philosophy room
philosophie.alt: The philosophy seminar room of the Faculté des Lettres on a cool morning, seen from the near right and slightly above: cream walls, honey oak floor, tall windows on the left onto the red-brick campus and a shooting star, and a blank slate chalkboard under a brass plate. On the left a brown mare in a white lace veil gazes out of the window, a boy in a yellow sweater at a front desk stares at a little green lizard on his book, a white-bearded professor holds out a red box of raisins and a judge in a black robe swears with a mug of strong tea. A St Bernard stands by the table with a little angel on his back reading a science book, and in front a girl with her eyes closed thinks beside a pot of purple pansies. On the right a brown owl on the table advises three elders in dark suits, and a young prince in a gold crown and red cape raises his palm. The tall oak double doors on the back wall open into the library, and the pale-green door with a question mark on the far right leads to the logic room.

doors.label: La bibliothèque
doors.hint: the tall oak double doors on the back wall, back to the library

doors.label: La logique
doors.hint: the pale-green door with the question mark at the far right, to the logic room

logique.name: La salle de logique · The logic room
logique.alt: The logic tutorial room of the Faculté des Lettres in afternoon light, seen from the near left: cream walls, tiled floor, tall windows on the left onto the red-brick campus and a bare autumn tree, and a long wall of dark green chalkboards covered in blank arrow-and-circle diagrams with a rolling ladder and a stuffed crow in a mortarboard on top. On the left a scholar in a green cardigan stacks teacups into a wobbling tower, a little girl in a swimsuit holds a bucket and spade, and a woman in a plaid shirt kneels by a pyramid of logs with a mouse on top. Behind them three boys wheel a gigantic book in a wheelbarrow, a girl in a red coat looks into a sunlit gilt mirror, and a lady in blue lifts her sandwich away from a line of ants. In the middle a girl detective with a magnifying glass inspects the muddy boot of a crowned duke, and an old philosopher in a toga reclines on a green sofa. On the right a young man lays raisins in arrows on a table, a bald man arranges traffic cones and a lion tamer shows a lion cub on a stool. The pale-green door on the left leads back to philosophy and the white door with balance scales at the back right leads to the ethics room.

doors.label: La philosophie
doors.hint: the pale-green door with the question mark on the left, back to the philosophy room

doors.label: L'éthique
doors.hint: the white door with the balance scales at the back right, to the ethics room

ethique.name: La salle d'éthique · The ethics room
ethique.alt: The ethics debating room of the Faculté des Lettres on a rainy day, seen from the front of the benches: cream walls, a marble floor, tiered oak benches in a half-circle, a tall window on the left, a big painted mural of a tortoise racing a hare on the back wall and a brass balance scale on a marble pedestal in the middle. On the left a wise old woman in a gray shawl holds up a bunch of sage, a child leaps up beside a popping jack-in-the-box, and in front a woman in an apron hands out morel mushrooms from a basket while a boy hides skewers of marshmallows. On the back benches a girl holds a latte, a runner lifts a relay baton, a girl compares two equal glasses of orange juice, and another girl reaches for a tray of filo pastries. By the pedestal a boy holds a dripping sponge over a puddle. On the right a smug man in a gown has an enormous long nose, a gray donkey trots between the benches and a potted fern wears a judge's wig. The white door with balance scales on the left leads back to the logic room and the dark-red door at the back right leads to the doctrines room.

doors.label: La logique
doors.hint: the white door with the balance scales on the left, back to the logic room

doors.label: Les doctrines
doors.hint: the dark-red door with the scroll at the back right, to the doctrines room

doctrines.name: La salle des doctrines · The doctrines room
doctrines.alt: The doctrines lecture hall of the Faculté des Lettres on a bright day, seen from the near right: cream walls with gilt-framed landscape paintings, a tiled floor, tall arched windows on the left onto a sunny lawn with a fountain, and a raised wooden platform with a lectern and a huge globe with a pigeon on top. On the left a woman films two boys waving identical blue flags with an old video camera, and in front a girl in a yellow dress plucks daisy petals beside a two-way signpost. Behind her a young woman in a beret unrolls a long scroll, a bearded man on the platform steps gazes at a fig, and a carpenter kneels to plant a teak sapling, his saw on the floor. On the platform two ducks share a bucket of water, a kind man helps a child up, and a young man reads a long scroll beside a feast table full of diners. On the right a man gapes in wonder at a white pony in a lace veil, a sour old man rolls his eyes at a sneezer, a mother dog lectures three puppies, and a man in a flat cap pulls a stingray in a wheeled tank. The dark-red door with a carved scroll on the far right leads back to the ethics room.

doors.label: L'éthique
doors.hint: the dark-red door with the scroll on the right, back to the ethics room

litterature.name: La salle de littérature · The literature room
litterature.alt: The literature seminar room of the Faculté des Lettres on an autumn afternoon, seen from the near right: cream walls, a honey oak floor, tall oak bookcases, a tall window on the left onto the red-brick campus, and a white marble fireplace with a gilt mirror and a plaster bust wearing a paper crown. On the left a grandmother in a blue shawl reads to two children with a big brass compass on her lap, a ginger cat lies with her kittens in a crate of old books, and at the back a tour guide with a red flag reads aloud to two boys beside a plaster knight whose broken foot lies on the floor. In the middle a girl in green on a footstool recites, holding up a posy, and an otter in a waistcoat sits at the long table opposite a smiling woman. On the right a Roman soldier reads a thick novel in an armchair, a cowboy reads a long scroll, and a writer types inside the open back of a cream toy van. The green door with the quill on the left leads back to the library, the plum door with the heart leads to the novels parlor and the navy door with the ink pot on the right leads to the writing workshop.

ecriture.name: L'atelier d'écriture · The writing workshop
ecriture.alt: The writing workshop of the Faculté des Lettres on a busy day, seen from the near right: whitewashed brick walls, tall arched windows onto the red-brick town, sheets of paper drying on lines and a big black printing press with a red wheel at the back. On the left a green furry creature writes with a giant quill, children watch a knight and a dragon in a red puppet theater, a pigtailed girl pulls an orange into segments, and a young woman with a pencil watches a line of big ants march along her desk. A goose glares at a pot of quills. On the right a shah in a jewelled turban reads to a boy, two diplomats in powdered wigs shake hands over a tea tray, a little girl on an old wooden chair writes at a small desk, a bald editor in a green eyeshade crosses out a page with a red pencil, and a bearded man leans back in fright as a paper spring snake pops out of his book. The navy door with the ink pot on the left leads back to the literature room and the lilac door with the lyre on the right leads to the poets' corner.

romans.name: Le salon des romans · The novels parlor
romans.alt: The novels parlor of the Faculté des Lettres on a rainy afternoon, seen from the near left: cream walls, a red patterned carpet, green velvet sofas, a tall potted palm and a big bay window with green curtains onto the misty campus garden and its fountain. On the left two ladies in feathered hats whisper beside the palm, a lady in a deerstalker writes at a little desk beside a big black crow, and a girl in a silver space helmet sits at a candlelit table with a tin robot; at the back a man weaves at a loom topped by two toy trams. On the right an old man in an Elizabethan ruff flies out of a giant book, a boy in a red pedal car punches the air, a vampire count with a candle tells a tale to three children on the sofa, and a man in a trench coat and fedora peers over a big newspaper. A parrot by the window wears a tiny deerstalker. The plum door with the heart on the left leads back to the literature room and the white door with the laurel wreath on the right leads to the mythology hall.
